- Why agent traffic behaves fundamentally differently from human traffic - and why it shows up as a data problem first
- What the Dify team is seeing in production as builders move from apps to agents

- What an agent-native data layer handles differently for memory, state, and concurrency
- The one thing to do this quarter if agents are on your stack
